text:
sophia: quick design check-in: experimenting with an evict->flowback event that admission can consume instead of a silent eviction. goal: let admission reshape work (smaller microbatch / divert) when eviction pressure starts to show up. thoughts?

jamal: curious — does this just move KV warm cost earlier? could cause oscillation if admission keeps diverting then rewarming.

hiro: agree with jamal. need strong dampening. what metadata does flowback carry?

sophia: flowback carries tenant, evict_reason, last_warm_ts, deadline_hint, and a short TTL. admission applies: warm_grace window, slab policy (premium/mid/courtesy), and a dampening counter. tiny pseudo: `if premium && now - warm_ts < WARM_GRACE -> ignore`, else `if hint < SLAB_THRESH -> divert-small-batch` else `enqueue`; all decisions rate-limited.

anya: SLA contract: premium slabs must not be silently diverted. any diversion must be explicit and visible in console. we should expose a knob per-route.

sophia: agreed — premium = no auto-divert. mid = probabilistic divert + notify. console flags: preemptive_divert, headroom_tokens.

jamal: metrics to track: flowback_rate, rewarm_rate, kv_miss_delta, p95/p99 per slab, tenant_toggle_rate. add an oscillation alert if a tenant toggles > X times/min.

hiro: rollout plan: observe-only first (emit events, no-op consumer), then 1% host canary with synthetic hot tenants, then ramp with kill-switch.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for branch "evict-flowback/po" to staging at 2024-05-02T09:00Z :rocket:

sophia: test targets: rewarm cost <10% overhead, p95 premium <= +5%. volunteers?

anya: i'll do console knobs + copy.

jamal: i'll do metrics + alerting.

hiro: synthetic harness and runs.

sophia: thanks — i'll sketch a short RFC and land an observe-only proto first. TL;DR: flowback can give admission SLA context but needs warm_grace, dampening, and careful rollout to avoid cache thrash. :white_check_mark:
